description: Add tickers to the user's TickerDB watchlist (one per account, shared with the website's Track buttons and Claude/ChatGPT watchlist links). Idempotent: already-present tickers come back in already; unknown ones in unknown. No ticker limit; free. Then get_watchlist_diff (call_tool) reports what changed for them since the last check: score, upside and downside potential, earnings, big price moves, trend changes, RSI oversold, volume spikes, insider trades, analyst changes, serious 8-K filings and dividend cuts.
name: add_watchlist_tickers
